title: The CI alarm (actions/ci-alarm) also reads reverts: it does not open an alarm for a run the merge tool now lifts
why: An alarm for a run the merge tool has already lifted wakes the batch runner for nothing, and an alarm that cries wolf gets ignored.
source: Lane red-main-owner-two-picks (session_013NEJL3KFBPuQT45U4xo8mE) 14:50 CST Nov 13, via the coordinator 14:51; owner 745 b (merges resume when the revert merges); ruling R53 (a CI or merge alarm goes to the batch runner).
note: Filed 14:51 CST Nov 13 as a TRIAGE PICK, not an owner ruling: no past ruling answers whether the alarm reads reverts (R53 says only that each CI or merge alarm wakes the batch runner; steps ci-alarm-reads-by-event and ci-alarm-read-fail-unknown are the nearest). Pick: yes, as its own lane; the lane (#3267 code, #3268 decision) starts nothing on it. Undo: close the lane and keep the alarm as is. Risk to check: the lane's own note revert-clear-masks-older-break (a revert clearing an older break). Shared tool, so it changes the alarm for every repo, with no per-repo exception. A check's verdict changes: test-author red case first, builder, reviewer. Lane's reading unread by triage. Lane 14:52 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 14:52): session_013NEJKzGKUSdCcES3LYPJZv, started 14:52. Told to read and stack on or wait for #2875 and #2920 (same alarm) and #3267 (merge tool lift).
